content.comment_body: Hi [user_name], I downloaded the file from your provided link and followed the instructions in the help [document] to ensure I added the add-in correctly. When I check the Excel options it’s shown as an active application add-in, but I don't see it anywhere in the interface. Do you know if there are known issues with Excel 365 Pro Plus and this add-in? Thank you very much for your assistance.

Hello [user_name], Try this in Excel: Go to File > Options > Trust Center > 'Trust Center Settings...'. Then navigate to 'Trusted Locations' and add the directory where you placed the [product_name] plug-in.
A new question from [user_name] was split to a separate discussion titled 'Is it possible to access the SD through the [product_name]'. Best regards CS Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble accessing and using the [product_name] add-in with Excel, even after installation and verification that it is active. There are concerns about compatibility with Excel 365 Pro Plus, specifically regarding integration and visibility of the add-in in the application. The main issues revolve around how easily the software can be discovered and used within this third-party environment.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] add-in to be straightforward to find and interact with in Excel after installation and activation, and to work reliably with their version of Excel.
